title: Partition Labels
prompt:
Partition the lowercase string `s` into as many parts as possible so that each letter appears in at most one part. Return the sizes of the parts, in order.

**Example**: `"ababcbacadefegdehijhklij"` → `[9,7,8]` (`"ababcbaca"`, `"defegde"`, `"hijhklij"`).

**Constraints**: `1 ≤ s.length ≤ 500`.
hints: If a part contains the letter 'a', what is the earliest position where that part can end?
At or after the last occurrence of 'a'. Precompute the last index of every letter, then sweep, stretching the current part's end to cover every letter you have seen.
`end = Math.max(end, last[c]); if (i == end) { sizes.add(end - start + 1); start = i + 1; }`

solution.explanation: A part must reach the last occurrence of every letter it contains, so `end` is the smallest valid end of the current part. Cutting as soon as `i == end` is the earliest legal cut, which leaves the most room for later parts and gives the most parts. O(n) time, O(1) space (a 26-slot table).
